[SWS_DM_00202] Check for Supported RoutineIdentifier and Reaction
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04224
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall check, whether the RoutineIdentifier ad-
dressed by the UDS Service RoutineControl (0x31) is supported by an existing
Di-
agnosticRoutine
with a matching
id
in the configuration. If the RoutineIdentifier
addressed by the UDS Service RoutineControl (0x31) is not supported a negative re-
sponse with NRC 0x31 (
kRequestOutOfRange
) shall be returned.
⌋
